annotations.title: Move a post or page to the trash

description: Moves ONE post or page to the trash. ⚠️ If it is live, visitors stop seeing it straight away, so only do this when the owner asked for this item. Trash is not delete: restore-content brings it back, and nothing here can delete permanently or empty the trash. Refused for the homepage, the blog page and a post somebody has open in the editor. Limited to 10 items an hour across the whole site, so check you have the right id first.
name: agentimus-trash-content
